# Paw-M Veterinary Clinic

> Paw-M is a boutique veterinary hospital in New Cairo, Egypt. We provide same-day diagnostics, transparent estimates and 24/7 emergency care for dogs, cats, birds, rabbits and exotic pets.

## Services

- General Checkup — full physical exams with written wellness plans
- Vaccination — core and lifestyle vaccines with automatic reminders
- Surgery — soft tissue and orthopaedic procedures in a sterile theatre
- Emergency Care — 24/7 triage with on-call critical care staff
- Laboratory — in-house bloodwork and cytology with same-visit results
- Dental Care — scaling, polishing and extractions under monitored anaesthesia
- Pharmacy — on-site dispensing verified against your pet's chart
- Grooming — medicated baths and coat care supervised by clinical staff
- Nutrition — weight and diet programmes built around measurable targets
- Digital X-Ray — low-dose digital radiography read within the same appointment
- Ultrasound — abdominal and cardiac imaging by certified sonographers
- Digital Records — every visit, result and prescription in one shareable history

## Booking

Appointments can be booked online at https://pawmclinnic.com/book in under a minute. Walk-in emergencies are accepted 24/7.

## Pet Store

Paw-M operates an online pet supply store at https://pawmclinnic.com/store with food, treats, toys, grooming supplies and health accessories for dogs and cats.

## About

Paw-M was built around clear diagnostics, honest estimates and medical records pet owners actually own. Our team of licensed veterinarians has an average of 12 years of practice across five specialties.
